voiceover: Is there a God? This section lays out the great arguments for God's existence — here is what each one asks. It opens with the cosmic questions — does a universe that began, and that did not have to exist, need a cause? Then the fine-tuning of the universe for life, and the debate over what best explains it. You will find the arguments from consciousness and reason, from our moral sense, from beauty, and from our deepest desires. And the hardest objection of all — the problem of suffering — faced head-on, not dodged. Every one of these arguments gets a fully-cited deep-dive essay. Each claim is sourced, and the strongest objections are stated fairly, then answered. That is our standard — Checked Before Published. And you will not just read. On every essay an AI tutor answers your questions — ask it anything, or highlight a single sentence and ask about that exact line. Mastery mode lets you explain the argument back in your own words and have it graded. Daily practice brings the key points back just as you are about to forget them. There are pocket cards to share, and a Debate Arena to practise against an AI sceptic before the real conversation. Every essay comes in a plain-English version and a full deep dive, with read-aloud audio. None of these is a knock-down proof, and we don't pretend otherwise. Together they make the case that a mind stands behind the universe — not yet the God of the gospel, but the door he walks through. Start anywhere, and follow it where it leads.
